description: Render a typeset card from a template — a finished, on-brand social image (a quote, a post, one big number, a small table, a checklist, an event) in about two seconds. Cheaper and more legible than generating type with a model, and the right choice where AI imagery is off-limits. Get the templates and their slots from list_templates.

oneOf.description: Apply your saved brand kit (set with PUT /v1/brand-kit)
Optional brand overlay composited into a corner after generation. Provide EITHER text OR logo_id (an uploaded brand logo), not both.

logo_id.description: A logo uploaded via POST /v1/logos (mutually exclusive with text)

logo_style.description: Logo treatment (logo_id only). RECOMMENDED default "sticker": crisp die-cut border + drop shadow, legible on any photo. "shadow": drop shadow only (use when the logo already contrasts the scene). "outline": border only, flat cut-out. "none": bare logo, its own alpha only (use only for a pre-processed logo on a controlled background).

size.description: text cap-height or logo width; default m

text.description: Handle to render, ≤64 chars, single line (mutually exclusive with logo_id)

scale.description: device pixel ratio; 2 default, 3 costs $0.01 more

slots.description: The template's slot values, e.g. { "quote": "…", "handle": "@you" }. Image slots take an asset id from upload_asset, or "default" for your brand kit.

style.description: Leave unset for the template default, "auto" for a random combination that avoids your last one, "brand" for your saved colours, or an object of style axes.

shadow.description: crisp offset shadow behind the type

name: render_template
